name: Lawve AI
description: Browse a curated library of legal AI skills written by practicing lawyers, in-house counsel, and legal technologists. Every skill covers a specific workflow — contract review, NDA analysis, GDPR compliance, legal drafting, jurisdiction-specific research. Search the catalog from inside Claude to find the skill that fits your task and preview its practitioner-authored instructions. Bring expert guidance into your workflow — whether you're at a law firm, in-house, or building legal tech.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lawve AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lawve AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.lawve.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lawve AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lawve AI provides these MCP tools: lawvable_search_skills and lawvable_get_skill_manifest.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lawve AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lawve AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Lawve AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lawve AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lawve AI is developed by Lawve AI. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
